plan.notes: Source: https://acu.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Healthcare-Administration-BS.pdf (official ACU Online degree plan, 2026-2027 Academic Year, College of Leadership and Professional Studies, 100% ONLINE, 120 credit hours). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. Public & Community Health concentration modeled (PDF also offers a Change Management concentration). Caveats: (1) PDF arithmetic is inconsistent: 16 core courses (48 hrs) + 9 hrs concentration + 56 hrs gen-ed + 13 hrs electives = 126, not 120. Modeled with electives = 7 hrs so the plan sums to the official 120-hour total (48+9+56+7=120). (2) HCAD 491 capstone: 'For majors only. Senior year.' (placed in Year 4). (3) Semester placement is a recommended sequence; the PDF does not publish a semester-by-semester layout. No course prerequisites are stated in the PDF.

courses.choice_note: Choose 3 courses (9 hrs) from: COMO 408 Crisis Communication, HCAD 311 Current Issues in Global Public Health, HCAD 441 Introduction to Epidemiology, HCAD 461 Healthcare Disparities. (Change Management concentration also offered: COMO 408, LEAD 411, HCAD 412, ORCO 411, HCAD 432.)
